snapshot.text: Single-payer system run by the National Health Insurance Fund (NEAK). The Tisza government that took office in May 2026 has a new health ministry and promises serious changes to the system.

priorities.title: Reform of the health system
priorities.text: The new health minister has announced serious changes to Hungarian healthcare.

priorities.title: Access to life-saving medicines
priorities.text: The minister has set out plans for access to life-saving drugs.

priorities.title: Karikó as adviser
priorities.text: Nobel laureate Katalin Karikó accepted an advisory role at the health ministry.
